example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার কর্মচারীদের কঠোরভাবে দোহন করে লাভবান হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: He exploits his employees harshly to make profits.
The landlord is milking the farmers dry.
history: Originates from the agrarian practice of milking cows, metaphorically extended to extracting resources or labor unjustly in Bengali folklore and daily language.
note: Reflects socio-economic critiques in Bengali literature and society.
